detailReview.method: All 24 native-resolution contact sheets were inspected across three zoom bands; high-risk original 1600x1080 details were opened separately. A CALL InOut text/conductor collision found at 150 percent was fixed, guarded by an automated geometry invariant, regenerated, and rechecked at 75, 100, and 150 percent.

sheetReview.method: Every family sheet was inspected for framing, selection residue, conductor continuity, clipping, and operand/pin readability. The corrected Program sheets were rechecked after regeneration; all unchanged images were verified byte-identical to the previously reviewed set.

artifactSet.canonicalization: UTF-8 LF with final LF: tia-renderer-artifact-set-v1; selected; operandRepresentation; tagInformationDisplay; tagInformationPosition; sorted zoomLevels; detail file and hash sorted by file; sheet file and hash sorted by file

limitations: This is a hash-bound review of local RungProof renderer artifacts, not an installed TIA Portal comparison.
The generated PNGs and source manifest remain ignored ephemeral-local files; this source-tree verdict does not make the pixels portable.
The reviewed set covers unselected offline rendering with symbolic and absolute operands, tag information shown on operands, and 75, 100, and 150 percent zoom.
Two additional operand and tag-information display modes are automated only.
Installed-TIA selected, edit, and online captures, live PLC execution, project interchange, downloading, forcing, and commissioning remain unproved.
